decision: Enable a Phase 4 prototype terrain and hillshade layer from AWS Open Data Mapzen Terrarium DEM tiles while keeping the surface labelled as prototype until alignment, readability, mobile performance, and boundary treatment pass review.
uiSummary: Open DEM hillshade and 3D terrain for visual slope context only

coverage.boundaryPolicy: Prototype terrain requests are bounded to the NUS campus review area. Before production, visual QA must confirm no obvious unfinished square appears in map-first user states.
